summary: This Form 8-K filed by American Water Works Company, Inc. reports items from its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, including shareholder approval of amendments to the 2017 Omnibus Equity Compensation Plan and the Nonqualified Employee Stock Purchase Plan. It also discloses a filing related to a Kentucky-American Water general rate case. The filing covers routine corporate governance matters, compensatory plan amendments, and regulatory filings. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or restructuring is present. The CEO and CFO departures were not abrupt or forced; rather, the filing reflects standard annual meeting outcomes and plan updates. This is a routine current report, not a special situation.
